entries: Load and hitch point checking｜Check the load identification, weight source, center of gravity, hitch points, and travel path, and refer missing items to qualified personnel.｜Output a known/unknown list and do not release based on estimates.

Rigging selection｜Select slings, shackles, spreader beams, and connection methods per the approved plan and nameplate rated capacity.｜Record rigging numbers and applicable limits, and do not overload.

Pre-shift inspection｜Inspect slings, connecting components, nameplates, wear, and deformation; isolate and take out of service anything with suspected defects.｜Deliver inspection records and disposal status.

Connection and test lift｜Connect hitch points per the plan and perform a controlled test lift after personnel have cleared the danger zone.｜Observe stability; stop the machine and recheck on skewing or slipping.

Signals and movement cooperation｜Confirm communication, paths, and stop commands with the crane operator and signal personnel.｜Stop the action and reconfirm when sight lines or signals are interrupted.
Landing and handover｜Land stably, unload, remove rigging, and address damage or residual risk.｜Leave records of the load, rigging, anomalies, and the person taking over.
